item.title: RTT: Rif. 6269_All. 3 - Social Stratification and Socio-Demographic and Economic Transformations in Europe (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-08 Sociologia dei processi economici, del lavoro, dell'ambiente e del territorio

the researcher will be expected to undertake a research programme consistent with the scientific and methodological orientations of the Department and of the specific disciplinary field GSPS-08/, with particular reference to the intersection between the dimension of social stratification—including the analysis of individual socioeconomic status and economic inequalities—and broader social, demographic, and economic transformations—including changes in welfare systems and labour markets—affecting European societies. The researcher will also be expected to make a significant contribution to the Department’s activities, including through teaching social research methods and techniques and data…
